summary: Defines how BGP can advertise IPv4 network layer reachability information using an IPv6 next hop. Previously the IPv4 address family definitions only allowed IPv4 next hops. It was later replaced by RFC 8950.

eli5.summary: A router can tell others about old-style addresses even when it is itself reached through the new style of address. This note makes that allowed. It was later replaced by RFC 8950.

questions: can bgp advertise ipv4 routes with an ipv6 next hop
how does extended next hop encoding work
